title: Lock, Unlock and Replacement Settings — Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
Any Gift Cards & Store Credit instrument can be locked for unauthorized use (use without the holder's permission), but only the bearer cards can also be locked as reported lost or reported stolen, and only three types can be replaced. For every type, a reported balance is protected from the time of the lock, and unlocking requires an identity verification passed in the same contact.

## Locking and unlocking

| Instrument type | Reasons for which it can be locked | Unlock requires a passed identity verification in the same contact | Reported balance protected from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note | Unauthorized use | Yes | The time of the lock |
| Bonus Gift Card | Reported lost, reported stolen, unauthorized use | Yes | The time of the lock |
| Goodwill Credit | Unauthorized use | Yes | The time of the lock |
| Return Store Credit | Unauthorized use | Yes | The time of the lock |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Reported lost, reported stolen, unauthorized use | Yes | The time of the lock |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | Reported lost, reported stolen, unauthorized use | Yes | The time of the lock |

## Replacement

| Instrument type | Replaceable if lost, stolen or compromised | Needs registration to the holder before the lock, or the purchase order line on record | Type issued as the replacement | Settlement wait after the lock (business days) | Most replacements per customer in a trailing 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note | No | No | Not applicable | 0 | 0 (not replaceable) |
| Bonus Gift Card | No | No | Not applicable | 0 | 0 (not replaceable) |
| Goodwill Credit | No | No | Not applicable | 0 | 0 (not replaceable) |
| Return Store Credit | Yes | No | Return Store Credit | 0 | 2 |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Yes | Yes | Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | 1 | 2 |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | Yes | Yes | Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | 1 | 2 |

The settlement wait is the number of business days a locked instrument stays locked before a replacement can be issued, letting pending charges settle.

## Reading the settings

- A plastic Marlowe & Finch Gift Card is replaced by a Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card, not by another plastic card.
- A Return Store Credit has no settlement wait and needs no registration or purchase record to be replaced.
- A Bonus Gift Card can be locked as reported lost or stolen but cannot be replaced.
